edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner_ by the onlyOwner modifier gating proposeOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == pendingOwner_ and then assigns owner_ = msg.sender.
Privileged adapter registration is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
Privileged adapter removal is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
Privileged adapter update is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
returnLostTokens is owner-only and drains all contract ETH/ERC20 to an arbitrary beneficiary.
executeActionExternal requires msg.sender == address(this) before executing an action.
When no signature is supplied msg.sender becomes the account that receives all returned funds.
executeActions is payable, nonReentrant and callable by any untrusted msg.sender.
owner_ is read by the onlyOwner modifier to authorise proposeOwnership.
pendingOwner_ is read by the onlyPendingOwner modifier to authorise acceptOwnership.
owner_ is overwritten with msg.sender inside acceptOwnership.
guard_ is checked and set LOCKED by the nonReentrant modifier on executeActions.
executeActionExternal calls into executeAction without its own lock, relying on guard_ state.
nonce_ of the recovered signer is compared with data.nonce for replay protection.
domainSeparator_ is used to build the EIP712 digest that is ecrecovered.
protocolAdapterRegistry_ is queried to resolve the adapter address for an action.
core_ is invoked with executeActions carrying actions, outputs and account.
CHI gas token contract is called via freeUpTo after execution to reclaim gas.
FEE_LIMIT bounds the fee share accepted by transferTokens.
DELIMITER is the denominator for fee and relative-amount computations in transferTokens.
_protocolAdapterNames drives the loop that aggregates balances in getBalances.
_protocolAdapterAddress supplies the adapter used for the external getBalance call.
_protocolAdapterSupportedTokens supplies the token list iterated in getAdapterBalances.
executeActions loops over the actions array calling executeAction for each element.
executeActions returns the result of returnTokens after all actions run.
returnTokens calls checkRequirementAndTransfer for each required output and leftover token.
startExecutionInternal first calls transferTokens to pull inputs and fees.
startExecutionInternal calls modifyOutputs before forwarding to Core.
transferTokens resolves each input amount through getAbsoluteAmount.
transferTokens pulls tokens from the account using SafeERC20 safeTransferFrom.
transferTokens computes fee amounts with Router.mul.
transferTokens forwards the ETH fee and remaining msg.value through low-level calls.
returnLostTokens sends the whole ETH balance to the beneficiary via low-level call.
checkRequirementAndTransfer sends ETH to the account via a low-level call.
checkRequirementAndTransfer moves ERC20 balances with safeTransfer.
returnLostTokens moves ERC20 balances with safeTransfer.
safeTransfer delegates the actual token interaction to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom delegates the actual token interaction to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove delegates the actual token interaction to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level address(token).call(data).
getAccountFromSignature first splits the raw signature into v, r and s.
getAccountFromSignature ecrecovers the signer from the EIP712 digest.
splitSignature extracts r, s and v from memory using inline assembly.
getAbsoluteAmountDeposit computes relative amounts with the mul helper.
getAbsoluteAmountWithdraw computes relative amounts with the mul helper.
mul multiplies a * b and validates with a division to detect overflow.
getAbsoluteAmount computes relative amounts with Router.mul.
Router.mul multiplies a * b and validates with a division to detect overflow.
toString relies on the loop counter i = length - 1 underflowing when length is zero.
startExecutionInternal invokes Chi.freeUpTo with a gas-derived value after execution.
getBalances delegates the raw adapter queries to getAdapterBalances.
getAdapterBalances loops over adapter names calling getAdapterBalance.
addProtocolAdapters loops calling the internal addProtocolAdapter helper.
removeProtocolAdapters loops calling the internal removeProtocolAdapter helper.
updateProtocolAdapters loops calling the internal updateProtocolAdapter helper.
startExecutionSig verifies the signature to derive the paying account.
startExecutionSig forwards to the internal startExecution implementation.
executeAction delegatecalls the resolved adapter with the deposit/withdraw selector.
The delegatecall invokes InteractiveAdapter.deposit in the Core storage context.
The delegatecall invokes InteractiveAdapter.withdraw in the Core storage context.
The delegatecalled adapter code is reached by an untrusted caller and may re-enter Core entrypoints.
The ETH low-level call to the account hands execution to the untrusted caller mid-settlement.
Low-level ETH transfers to a beneficiary/account can invoke a contract that re-enters.
The low-level token call in callOptionalReturn can invoke attacker-controlled token code.
Chi.freeUpTo performs an external call to the gas token contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists to be stored by proposeOwnership, so it collapses into that function node.
The newProtocolAdapterNames array parameter is consumed only by addProtocolAdapters.
The protocolAdapterNames array parameter is consumed only by removeProtocolAdapters.
The account parameter is the sole subject of the getBalances aggregation.
The account parameter of getAdapterBalance is forwarded to the adapter query inside getAdapterBalance.
The signature parameter is processed solely by getAccountFromSignature.
The TransactionData parameter is hashed and its nonce checked only in getAccountFromSignature.
The account parameter is the settlement target of executeActions.
The requiredOutputs parameter is enforced by executeActions via returnTokens.
The token parameter is the settlement subject of checkRequirementAndTransfer.
The account parameter is the transfer recipient in checkRequirementAndTransfer.
The inputs parameter is iterated and consumed by transferTokens.
The fee parameter is validated and applied inside transferTokens.
The account parameter supplies the balance source for getAbsoluteAmount.
Local c holds the a * b product that Router.mul overflow-checks before returning.
